description: This file defines the ServicePeriod class, a filter field used in reporting within the OrangeHRM system. It provides functionality to add date-based conditions to database queries related to an employee's service duration, based on operators like less than, greater than, and between, by calculating date differences with respect to the employee's joined date.

classes.name: ServicePeriod
classes.description: A filter class for querying employee service periods in reports, allowing conditions such as less than, greater than, and between, based on employee join dates.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds date difference conditions to the query builder based on the operator and 'X' and 'Y' parameters representing years.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the alias used for the main entity in queries, which is 'employee'.
